name: Chateau de Maisons (Maisons-Laffitte)

dates.built: 3e quart 17e siècle (as the Inventaire notice states the principal campaign), with the date 1646 borne on the fabric
dates.altered: The Inventaire notice names Bélanger and Peyre among later authors and gives '4e quart 18e siècle ; 3e quart 19e siècle' as secondary campaigns; it also records 'Remploi remploi provenant de : 80, Mailly'.
dates.note: THE REGISTER AND THE CORPUS DISAGREE ABOUT WHEN THIS WAS BUILT AND NEITHER IS CHANGED. The node's exemplar says 'François Mansart, 1630-1651'. The Inventaire notice IA00064664 prints 'Année(s) de(s) campagne(s) de construction 1646' with the comment 'porte la date', and gives the principal campaign as '3e quart 17e siècle' - the third quarter, i.e. 1650-1675 - which places nothing at all in 1630. A search-result summary read the same day repeated the corpus's '1630 to 1651'; that is a summary and is not quoted here.

measurements.name: full_storey_count
measurements.note: An 'étage carré' is a full storey above the ground floor in the Inventaire's vocabulary, so the notice describes a basement storey, ONE full upper storey and two attic storeys. It is not a total storey count and is not read as one.

measurements.name: attic_storey_count
measurements.note: TWO habitable attic storeys inside the roof. This is the figure that matters to this node: the corpus's own prose says Mansart's generation kept 'the habitable attic French building needed while cutting the silhouette's height nearly in half', and the register says the attic is two storeys deep.

measurements.name: roof_covering_material_count
measurements.note: Slate, and only slate; carried as a count of one because the enum has no categorical unit and the fact worth recording is that the register names a single covering.

note: Tranche 3, 5 Sep 2026. The richest register description in this cluster and the model for what an Inventaire (IA) notice can do that a protection (PA) notice cannot: materials, plan type, storey composition, roof forms and stair types, in the register's own controlled vocabulary. It states no dimension. No rights line was read, so no `rights_evidence`.
